mapper.insert: merge into COM_DEVICE_SYN_KEY target using (select #{deviceId} as DEVICE_ID, #{agmKeyCurverList,jdbcType=CLOB} as AGM_KEY_CURVER_LIST, #{stationCode} as STATION_CODE, #{respRetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as RESP_RET_CODE, #{respRetMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as RESP_RET_MSG, #{respKeyVersionCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} as RESP_KEY_VERSION_COUNT, #{processDurationMs,jdbcType=BIGINT} as PROCESS_DURATION_MS, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as STATUS, #{errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ERROR_MSG from dual) source on (target.DEVICE_ID = source.DEVICE_ID) when matched then update set target.AGM_KEY_CURVER_LIST = source.AGM_KEY_CURVER_LIST, target.REQ_SYN_KEY_DATE = systimestamp, target.STATION_CODE = source.STATION_CODE, target.RESP_RET_CODE = source.RESP_RET_CODE, target.RESP_RET_MSG = source.RESP_RET_MSG, target.RESP_KEY_VERSION_COUNT = source.RESP_KEY_VERSION_COUNT, target.PROCESS_DURATION_MS = source.PROCESS_DURATION_MS, target.STATUS = source.STATUS, target.ERROR_MSG = source.ERROR_MSG when not matched then insert (DEVICE_ID, AGM_KEY_CURVER_LIST, REQ_SYN_KEY_DATE, STATION_CODE, RESP_RET_CODE, RESP_RET_MSG, RESP_KEY_VERSION_COUNT, PROCESS_DURATION_MS, STATUS, ERROR_MSG, REG_DATE) values (source.DEVICE_ID, source.AGM_KEY_CURVER_LIST, systimestamp, source.STATION_CODE, source.RESP_RET_CODE, source.RESP_RET_MSG, source.RESP_KEY_VERSION_COUNT, source.PROCESS_DURATION_MS, source.STATUS, source.ERROR_MSG, systimestamp)
